seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in New Hope, MN for 2026: the Tri-City Santa Parade on December 5 and Skate with Santa at the New Hope Ice Arena.
lede: New Hope starts a Santa parade on its streets and offers a Friday night skate with Santa.
celebrates: New Hope is where the Tri-City Santa Parade begins, at Nevada Avenue and Medicine Lake Road, on December 5, before winding through Crystal and ending in Robbinsdale. The City of New Hope also hosts Skate with Santa at the New Hope Ice Arena on December 11 for $6 per person at the door.
lastyear: The New Hope Ice Arena posted about a Skate with Santa on Friday, December 12, 2025, from 6:30 to 8 pm with skating, treats and hot chocolate, according to the arena's Instagram post. The city lists the 2026 skate on its parks and recreation news page.
facts: The Tri-City Santa Parade passes through three cities in one evening. The New Hope Ice Arena skate costs $6 per person at the door. The parade's listed window on the City of Crystal's calendar is 5 to 8:30 pm.
trains: We did not find a holiday train in New Hope. CPKC's Holiday Train stops in Golden Valley on December 14 at 5 pm, and the Everly Express at Everly Farms in Minnetrista is the closest holiday train ride. The Holly Trolley and Night Trains are in Minneapolis and Saint Paul.
